FSP HYDRO PT series bases on the highest graded components (DC-DC module design, 100% Japanese capacitors) it features outstanding efficiency, voltage stability and ripple suppression. And thanks to high quality 135mm FDB fan, and ribbon cable design. The Platinum PSUs are extremely cool, quiet and also do well for gaming enthusiast and overclocker ever!
Hydro PT series are featured with intelligent fan speed control circuit design which uses a diameter of 135mm, fluid dynamic bearing, for low noise and reliable operation at low and medium loads.
LLC Half Bridge Topology with DC-DC Module Design
HYDRO PTM series features extremely tight voltage regulation to make the output voltage regulation under +/- 1% at any load change and offer you supreme efficiency and voltage stability.

Hydro PT series come with 80 Plus Platinum Certification which means your power supplies consume less heat and have a lower operating cost. The power supplies are guaranteed to operate at a minimum of 92% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power.
FSP is committed to continue to keep the products' quality and the trust our customers by manufacturing reliable power supplies. The Hydro PT serise comes with a 10 years warranty.
Unique Design, Stylish in DIY Spirit
The power supplies come with 3 changeable side stickers to show your style, perfect for DIY enthusiasts and gamers.
OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP, a full guardian of circuit protections to keep your hardware safe.
Accumulated 20 years of experience in power supply, FSP carefully selects every component to develop latest technology.

A new heat dissipation design that conducts heat through a thermal pad on the bottom of the power supply, transforming the whole PSU chassis into a heat-sink and cooled by system airflow.
